Liam (Auditor): Hey team — for the ISO/SOC2 review we need a concise evidence package. Scope: (A) RBAC change log for inference service accounts svc-infer-* from 2025-10-01 through 2026-02-28 with a one-line risk rationale per change; (B) KMS events (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/EnableKeyRotation) for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abc-rotation-v2 covering 2026-02-16..2026-02-19; (C) proof that emergency key rotation completed and that previous key material cannot be used. Aggregated CSV + raw exports + checksums preferred. Confirm scope and ETA?
Priya - SecEng: Confirmed. We'll produce: aggregated CSV (PR, change-summary, one-line-risk-rationale, deploy-id, event_id, line_index), raw CloudTrail JSONL for RBAC and KMS events, README with redaction rules, retention, checksums, and a one-paragraph summary of the rotation trigger. ETA 3h, preliminary package in 45m.
Omar Ops: Plan: filter CloudTrail for principalArns matching svc-infer-* and KMS keyId abc-rotation-v2. Correlate UpdateRole/PutRolePolicy events to GitHub PRs using commit hashes and deploy tags. Add deterministic line indices so you can request samples. I'll kick off export now.

Liam (Auditor): Good. A few follow-ups: 1) please embed a one-paragraph explanation of why the emergency rotation was run (trigger, date/time, and owner). 2) show a short test demonstrating Decrypt behavior before and after rotation (sanitized lines ok). 3) include SHA256 checksums for each artifact and retention period for those exports.
Omar Ops: Rotation summary we'll add: trigger = CVE-2026-02-16-XYZ affecting KMS client library; rotation initiated via playbook step by rotation-operator@redwood on 2026-02-18T04:05:12Z. We'll include runbook excerpt in README and a signed note from oncall.

Final asks before review: a) add per-PR one-line risk rationale for every RBAC delta, b) confirm retention (how long artifacts will be kept in the audit bucket) and c) confirm that any PII was redacted and the exact redaction rules.
